all_findings.title: Liability is unlimited
all_findings.comparison: Past contracts: 8 of 10 cap liability at about 1x fees; highest seen 2x.
all_findings.quote: Vendor's liability under this Agreement is unlimited. Client's liability is limited to the fees payable under this Agreement.

all_findings.title: Delay penalty with no exclusion for client-caused delay
all_findings.why: AtliQ could pay for delays it did not cause (Brightwater).
all_findings.comparison: Past contracts cap penalties at 5% of the milestone and exclude client delay (3 of 3).
all_findings.quote: If Vendor fails to complete any milestone by its due date, Vendor shall pay Client liquidated damages of two percent (2%) of the total project fee for each week of delay until completion.

all_findings.title: Client Owns Pre-Existing Tools
all_findings.why: AtliQ loses ownership of its proprietary pre-existing tools.
all_findings.comparison: Northwind is the only past exception; standard practice is AtliQ retains tools.
all_findings.quote: All work product, including Vendor's pre-existing tools incorporated in it, is owned by Client on creation.

all_findings.title: Indemnity Covers Client Negligence
all_findings.why: AtliQ takes on liability for the client's own negligent acts.
all_findings.comparison: Violates principle that AtliQ does not cover the other side's negligence.
all_findings.quote: including claims arising from Client's own negligence.

all_findings.title: No Payment for Work in Progress on Termination
all_findings.why: AtliQ could perform work and receive nothing if terminated for convenience.
all_findings.comparison: Violates principle that AtliQ is paid for work done on termination.
all_findings.quote: Client may terminate at any time for convenience without payment for work in progress.

all_findings.title: Payment in 60 days
all_findings.why: Long payment terms hurt cash flow.
all_findings.quote: Client shall pay each invoice within sixty (60) days of the invoice date.

all_findings.title: Restricted Vendor Termination Rights
all_findings.why: Deprives AtliQ of standard termination rights for material breach.
all_findings.comparison: Unusual restriction compared to standard commercial terms.
all_findings.quote: Vendor may terminate only for Client's non-payment continuing for ninety (90) days.

all_findings.title: Acme Retail Group: Soliciting the other party's employees involved in the Services
all_findings.why: Non-solicit obligation regarding Acme staff worldwide, depending on employee deployment for the new services.
all_findings.quote: During the term and for six (6) months thereafter, neither Party shall solicit any employee of the other Party who was involved in the Services.

all_findings.title: PayTrack Technologies: Soliciting the other party's employees engaged in the Services
all_findings.why: Non-solicit obligation regarding PayTrack staff worldwide, depending on employee deployment for the new services.
all_findings.quote: Neither Party shall solicit for employment the other Party's employees engaged in the Services during the term and for twelve (12) months thereafter.

all_findings.title: Northwind Logistics: Soliciting the other party's employees engaged in the Services
all_findings.why: Non-solicit obligation regarding Northwind staff worldwide, depending on employee deployment for the new services.
all_findings.quote: Neither party shall, during the term and for six (6) months afterwards, solicit any employee of the other party engaged in the Services.

all_findings.title: Sunrise Foods: Soliciting the other party's employees engaged in the Services
all_findings.why: Non-solicit obligation regarding Sunrise staff worldwide, depending on employee deployment for the new services.
all_findings.quote: Neither Party shall solicit the employees of the other Party engaged in the Services during the term of the relevant SOW and six (6) months thereafter.
